title: Subs. by s. 3, ibid., for sub-section (4) (w.e.f. 23-8-2021).
text:
4. Subs. by s. 3, ibid., for sub-section (4) (w.e.f. 23-8-2021).

5

-----

Bank of India Act, 1934 shall (except those specifically provided for under this Act) _mutatis mutandis_
apply to a factor which has been granted a certificate of registration under section 3.
